# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-25)

`ambiance1.jpg` and `ambiance2.jpg` are genuine Gemini generations as
of 2026-08-25 (generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool),
replacing the R logo (wrong software-logo asset) and an unrelated
Reddit screenshot that were previously in these slots.

- `ambiance1.jpg`: a wrinkled hand-annotated draft half-tucked under a
  clean, freshly bound report. Metaphor: a rough draft becoming a
  formal document.
- `ambiance2.jpg`: a carpenter's plane shaving a rough wooden board
  smooth. Metaphor: smoothing a rough draft into a polished report.

Both processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.

## Replacements, 2026-11-16

Placeholder or reused images were replaced, or empty slots filled, during an image audit of the whole blog. New images were generated with Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`) through the image MCP server, checked for logos and readable text, and converted with `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85`. Each line gives the slot, the generated file in `~/gen_image/`, and a summary of the prompt (scene; metaphor). Every prompt opened with 'Generate a 16:9 landscape image with the following description:' and closed with a lens, a genre, and 'no people, no logos, no readable text'.

- `ambiance3.jpg`: `pencil_draft_cream_report.png`. a pencil-marked draft beside a neatly bound report; a working script turned into a presentable report.
